name: E2E: Verify Agentforce-created incident exists in Salesforce with correct field values
objective: Validate that the incident created via portal Agentforce is accurately persisted in Salesforce with all conversation data mapped to the correct fields.
precondition: Incident INC-000001518 was created via Agentforce. Fulfiller has Salesforce access.

steps.description: Login to Salesforce sandbox as fulfiller
steps.testData: URL from .env.dev SF_SANDBOX_URL, credentials from SF_SANDBOX_USERNAME/SF_SANDBOX_PASSWORD. Uses stored session to bypass MFA.
steps.expectedResult: Fulfiller is authenticated in Salesforce Lightning

steps.description: Search for the incident using global search
steps.expectedResult: Incident appears in search results as a[title='INC-000001518']

steps.description: Open the incident record and validate fields

shortDescription.expected: Blue screen error when opening Microsoft Outlook after Windows update
shortDescription.actual: Blue screen error when opening Microsoft Outlook after Windows update

description.expected: Contains BSOD, KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR, KB5039211, Dell Latitude 5540
